description: Utilisation and growth per tenant and per repository, with a plain forecast such as “full in about 120 days”. The forecast is an estimate from the history, not a promise.
scopeTenant: This installation shows the capacity of its one tenant. The comparison of all tenants comes with Service Provider.
estimateNote: Every date on this page is an estimate: a straight line through the history, which real growth only follows roughly. It appears only where a limit is known.
loadError: The capacity figures could not be loaded.

stored.label: Stored in total
stored.hint: {count, plural, one {Over # tenant} other {Over # tenants}}, chunk store and repositories of machines, file shares and containers.

growth.label: Growth per day
growth.hint: Sum of the 30-day figures, with the 7-day figure for younger tenants. {count} of {total} tenants have one.

systemDisk.label: System disk
systemDisk.trendPending: The trend appears after six hours of measurements.
systemDisk.notWatchedHint: The server's system disk is not watched on this installation.

earliest.label: Runs full first
earliest.noneHint: No repository with a known limit is heading for its limit within ten years.

quota.label: Tenants near their quota
quota.hint: {count, plural, one {# tenant runs full} other {# tenants run full}} within {days} days at the estimate.
quota.hintNone: No tenant runs full within {days} days at the estimate.

basis.samples: From the daily measurements of the last {days} days: chunk store and repositories.
basis.packs: From the dates of the stored mail data, as net growth. Repositories of machines, file shares and containers are not counted until a week of daily measurements exists.
basis.none: Nothing is stored yet, or the history is too short.

full.from: From {date}, at the slowest growth not within ten years
full.noDate: Not within ten years at this growth
full.otherData: No date yet: machines, file shares or containers write there as well, and a week of daily measurements is still missing

detail.error: The repositories could not be loaded.
detail.forecastLine: A straight line through the last {days} days: {bytes} per day.
detail.forecastBand: A straight line through the last {days} days: {bytes} per day, between {slowest} and {fastest} per day in the slowest and the fastest week.
detail.noForecast: No estimate yet: there is not enough history.
detail.limitFilesystem: {free} free on the repository's filesystem, {total} in total.
detail.limitS3: An S3 bucket shows no limit, so no date is estimated.
detail.limitShared: This tenant stores on the installation's default repository, which other tenants use as well. Its free space is the server's, so no date is estimated here.
detail.limitUnknown: The free space of this repository could not be read.
detail.growthPending: Growth appears after a week of daily measurements.
detail.omitted: {count, plural, one {# more repository is not listed.} other {# more repositories are not listed.}}
detail.repositoriesNote: Machines, file shares and containers each keep a repository of their own; their growth is measured from the day this version was installed.

empty.noneDescription: The capacity appears once a tenant stores backups.
empty.filtered: No tenant is near its quota or heading for its limit
empty.filteredDescription: Nothing needs attention at the estimated growth.
